opening.argument: The presentation begins with an upfront payment requirement and connects that payment to participation in mining. It then promotes early participation as a route to obtaining cheap coins and earning profit through resale. The recruitment structure is equally direct: it displays company partners, awards points for inviting individuals, and describes bonuses when a partner is brought into the left or right side. Finally, buying the Tycoon is linked to token splits, accumulation, resale, and increased earnings. Together, these paid entry, mining-return, token-profit, and recruitment features establish the promotional structure at issue. The available evidence does not establish that the packages, payouts, or profits were actually delivered.
